items.name: Sponsor a Dahlia Bed
items.description: A whole bed of dahlias, blooming in your name all season. Your plaque stands at the end of the bed, and a season pass for one person comes with it.

items.name: Sponsor a Fruit Tree
items.description: A fruit tree planted and tended in the park, growing a little taller every year.

items.name: Sponsor a Picnic Table
items.description: A shady place to sit with a bouquet and a picnic, in the middle of the blooms.

items.name: Sponsor a Bench
items.description: A quiet bench along a path, where someone will linger a little longer than they planned.
